pricingModel: charge-point specific; CPO controls tariff; exact price displayed in Virta app or one-time-payment website before charging
rule: Never infer a Virta-wide tariff. Use only tariff components displayed for the exact charging point/charger ID on Virta's official one-time-payment website or mobile app, preserving energy, time, session and alternate-period components. Connected-to-Virta and roaming points may have different operators and prices. Any PAN EVSE without an exact deterministic match remains fail-closed/unpriced.
